Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing the Changeling Titan token.
When the Changeling Titan token dies, Kiki-Jiki is returned from exile to the battlefield.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability.

Holding priority, activate Haunted Crossroads by paying {B}, putting Priest of Gix from your graveyard onto the top of your library.

Resolve the Hammerhead ability from step 1.
Cast Priest of Gix from exile by paying at most {2}.
When Priest of Gix enters the battlefield, it triggers, adding {B}{B}{B}.
Repeat.

Resolve the Grimgrin ability.
Repeat.

Repeat.

Repeat each combat phase, using the Combat Celebrant token instead.

Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability.
Cast Carrion Feeder from the top of your library by paying 1 life.
Repeat.

Resolve the Krark-Clan Grunt ability.
Repeat from step 3.

Repeat.

Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing another nontoken green Insect.
When the Insect dies, Zask and Verdant Succession trigger.
Resolve the Zask trigger, putting the Insect on the bottom of your library from your graveyard and causing you to mill two cards.
Resolve the Verdant Succession trigger, searching your library for that Insect and putting it onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Shilgengar ability.
Repeat.
3781-4215-5686--124.notes: Eventually the combo will stop in step 3, as the Insect will be milled into your graveyard. Note that you must control another nontoken green Insect besides Zask.
